notes: Entries are matched in order; the first match wins, so put narrow entries before broad ones.

Grades reflect methodological transparency, quality assurance, corrections policy, institutional independence and disclosure of funding (PURPOSE 3.1b). They are not a statement about the political orientation or the conclusions of a source.
disputed: true caps the effective grade at C until the dispute is resolved.

entries.basis: Official national statistics; documented methodology and revision policy; independent of the reporting ministry.
entries.rationale: Official statistics produced under a published methodology and a legal mandate, with documented revisions.

entries.publisher: Eurostat (Statistical Office of the European Union)
aliases: Statistical Office of the European Union
entries.basis: Official supranational statistics; published methodology, quality reports and revision policy.
entries.rationale: Official European statistics with documented methods and quality reporting.

aliases: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development
entries.basis: Intergovernmental organisation; published methodology notes, source metadata and revisions per indicator.
entries.rationale: Comparable cross-country statistics with per-indicator methodology and source documentation.

entries.basis: Official police statistics with a published definition catalogue and methodology notes; annual, standardized collection across the Laender.
entries.rationale: Official crime statistics; the methodology notes are explicit about the difference between suspects and convictions, which is exactly the kind of disclosure the criteria require.

entries.publisher: Federal Statistical Office of Germany (Destatis) — GENESIS database
entries.basis: Official statistics database with documented definitions and revision policy.
entries.rationale: Same publisher and methodology as the statistical office; listed separately because the database documents series-level definitions.

entries.basis: Intergovernmental organisation; published methodology, estimates review and corrections.
entries.rationale: Global health estimates with published methods and uncertainty ranges.

entries.basis: Intergovernmental statistical bodies with published methodology and metadata.
entries.rationale: Official international statistics with documented definitions and revisions.

entries.basis: Intergovernmental organisation; per-indicator methodology and source documentation.
entries.rationale: Development statistics with documented indicator definitions and sources.

entries.basis: Peer review or an equivalent editorial quality-assurance process, a corrections/retraction policy and author conflict-of-interest disclosure.
entries.rationale: Journal articles that state their method and pass review meet all five criteria. Individual articles can still be weak; use the reported uncertainty and the study design, not the grade alone.

entries.basis: Registers publisher-supplied metadata; verifies existence and bibliographic match, not the content.
entries.rationale: Crossref confirms that a DOI and its metadata exist. It says nothing about the quality of the underlying document, so it is graded B and usually only used for tier-3 validation.

entries.basis: Research institute of the Federal Employment Agency; working papers and reports state data sources and methods; peer-reviewed outlets for core results.
entries.rationale: Administrative labour-market data with documented methods; the institute publishes its data sources and revision practice.

entries.basis: Established economic research institute; published data documentation and working-paper series; not peer reviewed throughout.
entries.rationale: Established research institute with transparent data documentation; its working papers are not all peer reviewed, so B rather than A.

entries.publisher: Federal Ministry for Family Affairs, Senior Citizens, Women and Youth (BMFSFJ)
aliases: Bundesministerium fuer Familie, Senioren, Frauen und Jugend
Bundesministerium für Familie, Senioren, Frauen und Jugend
entries.basis: Government ministry; commissioned expert reports name their authors and data sources, but the publishing body has a policy interest.
entries.rationale: The reports are commissioned research with named authors and data sources, but the publisher is a ministry with a policy position; B reflects that without judging the findings.

entries.basis: Specialist information service; commissions expert reports with named authors and cited sources; organizational funding is disclosed.
entries.rationale: The expert reports cite their data and authors; the service itself is an advocacy-adjacent information provider, so B rather than A.

entries.basis: Government publications; primary documents with named responsibility, but a policy interest and no independent review.
entries.rationale: Primary government documents are citable, but the publisher has a policy interest; B reflects that.

entries.basis: Supranational executive; documents name their method and data sources, but the institution has a policy interest.
entries.rationale: Methodologically documented but policy-driven; B rather than A.

entries.basis: Structured expert review at multiple stages, published uncertainty language, full source traceability.
entries.rationale: Assessment reports undergo successive expert and government review with explicit uncertainty treatment and traceable sources.

entries.basis: EU agency; published methodology, quality assurance and revision practice for its indicators.
entries.rationale: Official environmental reporting with documented methods and indicator metadata.

entries.basis: Federal agency with a scientific mandate; published methods, data sources and review of its reports.
entries.rationale: Official environmental data with documented methodology and sources.

entries.basis: Federal public-health institute; published surveillance methods, case definitions and weekly reports with revisions.
entries.rationale: Official public-health surveillance with published case definitions and method notes.

entries.basis: Systematic reviews with a published protocol, explicit risk-of-bias assessment and conflict-of-interest policy.
entries.rationale: Systematic reviews follow a pre-registered protocol and an explicit appraisal method.

entries.basis: Working-paper series; methods and data are documented, but papers are circulated before peer review.
entries.rationale: Transparent working papers that have not necessarily been peer reviewed; B rather than A.

entries.publisher: Quality journalism with a published corrections policy
entries.basis: Editorial review and a corrections policy, but no systematic method disclosure or peer review.
entries.rationale: Journalism can be accurate and useful, but it does not normally disclose method well enough for a higher grade.

entries.basis: Moderation and identifier assignment, but no peer review at the time of posting.
entries.rationale: Preprints are citable but unreviewed; use them as leads or as context, not as a decisive source.

entries.basis: The organization pursues a stated political or campaign goal; material is not independently reviewed.
entries.rationale: Advocacy material of every orientation is graded by the same rule: it documents a position. It can be cited as a position, but not as an independent source for the gate.

entries.basis: No stable editorial responsibility for the individual statement; no method disclosure.
entries.rationale: Useful for orientation and for finding primary sources, but not citable as verified evidence.

entries.basis: No editorial review, no method disclosure, unstable availability.
entries.rationale: Never verdict-bearing. Recorded so that such material is graded explicitly rather than by accident.
